definitions.short: Chetsron , the name of a place in Palestine; also of two Israelites
definitions.full: H2696. Chetsron חֶצְרֹן חֶצְרוֺן, proper name, of a location and person (compare Sabean חצֿרן proper name, of a location or tribe Hal No. 661 DHM ZMG 1883, 15 ) — 1. proper name, of a location ᵐ5 Ασωρων , Ασερων , Εσρωμ : a. חֶצְרוֺן Josh 15:3 place in extreme south of Judah, + אַדָּ֫רָה = חֲצַראַֿדָּר (q. v.) Num 34:4 . b. חָצוֺר הִיא חֶצְרוֺן קְרִיּוֺת Josh 15:25 another town of Judah in south. 2. proper name, masculine ᵐ5 Ασρωμ ( ν ), Εσρων , etc.: a. חֶצְרֹן son of Reuben Gen 46:9 ; Exod 6:14 ; Num 26:6 = חֶצְרוֺן 1Chr 5:3 . b. son of Peres and grandson of Judah Gen 46:12 ; Num 26:21 = חֶצְרוֺן Ruth 4:18-19 , 1Chr 2:5 , 9 , 18 , 21 , 24 (twice in verse); 2:25 ; 4:1 .
